title: Attenuation, modelled: three steps narrow a grant, and one widening move is refused.
caption: MODEL; the account cannot install an attenuated grant at the pinned build (proposed). Parent: rule `play`: the game, any function, `app` or `helper`, threshold 1, last ledger 5000; rule `shop`: XLM, `transfer`, recipient is the shop, `app` or `helper`, threshold 1, cap 10 per 100 ledgers. Steps: 1. restrict `play` to `guess`; 2. lower the cap limit to 4; 3. remove the signer `helper` from `shop`. Refused: raise the cap limit to 20 (a higher limit); nothing changes. Each probe runs alone from empty records. The child accepts 2 of 7, and the parent accepts each of them.
